messages:
maria-partnerops: quick question for partners thread — we got the draft supply numbers from Nebula but the windows look odd. can someone confirm: are their 'ephemeral pool' SKUs available in Q2 only for day windows (08:00-20:00 PT) or is that a continuous allocation?
aj-finance: I saw the same. the pricing sheet says 'ephemeral (spot) — variable capacity, 20% floor' but no window specified. would matter for our hourly cost model.
sanjay-partnerships: pinged our Nebula contact; they said pool is 'mostly day' for the next 90 days due to other commitments. asked for a formal schedule.
maria-partnerops: ok — that implies we can't assume 24/7 spot baseline. can we model two scenarios: (A) spot day-only availability, (B) spot intermittent with 30% reliability?
kevin-procurement: for Reserved/commit tiers they offered 6/12/24mo terms. important: 6mo reserved has a 12% discount vs on-demand, 12mo is 22%. i'll attach quick numbers.
supply-bot: uploaded file: https://redwood-internal/sheets/partner_supply_nebula_v2 (permissions: partners-read).
ellie-ops: FYI KV-cache-heavy workloads care about tail windows. if spot disappears at 20:00 our latency SLOs could regress — we'll need to route to dedicated during evening hours.
maria-partnerops: noted. aj-finance can you run delta to show cost-per-token for scenario A vs B plus fallback to dedicated evening?
aj-finance: sure. rough back-of-envelope: daily avg cost with day-only spot = 0.65x on-demand during day, but fallback to dedicated nights bumps monthly by ~8% for the example workload. intermittent spot (30% reliability) increases fallback to 14%. i'll send spreadsheet.
sanjay-partnerships: nebula also mentioned occasional 'commit swap' windows where they lift day-only to 24h for a week if we take extra reserved blocks. could we include an option in the model: "ephemeral-boost (one-week)" with assumed probability 0.2?
maria-partnerops: yes include a parameter for ephemeral-boost probability. also need a clear field for 'spot floor' (min price) — Nebula quoted a soft floor at 20% of on-demand but legal said not guaranteed. mark as vendor-asserted.
kevin-procurement: i'll draft a vendor clause asking for explicit window SLAs in the marketplace listing. if they won't commit we need a price premium for our reserved offers.
ellie-ops: can we schedule a 30-min sync with Nebula and product to nail windows + example RLUs? pref 10am PT tomorrow.
sanjay-partnerships: I'll invite Nebula commercial + engineering. adding agenda: 1) day vs 24h windows, 2) spot floor guarantees, 3) ephemeral-boost mechanics, 4) reporting cadence.
maria-partnerops: perfect. last ask — please add a sample JSON snippet in the shared sheet for our cost model input schema (fields: sku, term_months, reserved_pct, spot_floor_pct, window_start, window_end, boost_probability).
aj-finance: adding snippet now in the sheet under 'model_inputs' tab.
maria-partnerops: thanks all :pray: we'll update the cost run and push to the marketplace pricing doc after the sync.
